name: Minghan Wang
bio: My interests span multilingual and multimodal AI, reasoning, and intelligent agents. What connects these areas is a broader ambition: to build intelligent, efficient, and interactive AI systems that work alongside people, help push the frontiers of scientific discovery, and make everyday life better. I enjoy turning ideas into working code—building, testing, and refining systems until they do something useful. It is an exciting time to work in AI, and I am eager to contribute to what comes next.
